items.text: Cardinals trading Marvin Harrison Jr. (and 2027 7th) to Texans for 2027 2nd and 6th; MHJ inactive today amid deal. Confirmed by Schefter/Ryans.
items.why: Blockbuster finalized Sunday; inactive while deal worked.
items.implication: MHJ fresh start with Stroud; ARI WR room opens immediately, HOU depth improves ROS.
items.opportunity: Michael Wilson elevated targets/routes in ARI; HOU WRs (Nico) long-term competition but short-term boost possible.

items.text: Terry McLaurin active (with Keenan Allen, Jeanty); expected limited snaps post-hamstring, rainy conditions.
items.why: Cleared after limited Friday practice; Garafolo noted not full go.
items.implication: Risky WR3/flex; snap count likely restricted with Diggs also out and Daniels returning.
items.opportunity: Primary WR targets if volume holds despite limits.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty is a go after being hopeful/GTD with plantar fasciitis/ankle; elevated RB as contingency unused.
items.why: Pregame workout cleared; Rapoport then ETR final update.
items.implication: Start Jeanty; monitor for limited workload early.
items.opportunity: Lead back carries/routes if healthy enough.

items.text: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson is active today vs. the Saints. Jordan Addison and Odell Beckham Jr. are inactive.
items.why: Jefferson cleared; Addison inactive despite practice return.
items.implication: Start Jefferson; Addison out elevates secondary options slightly but Jefferson volume intact.
items.opportunity: Jefferson full target share without Addison.

items.text: Bengals WRs Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins, both listed as questionable, both will play against the Dolphins.
items.why: Cleared after questionable tag; Schefter confirmation matched ETR final updates.
items.implication: Start both as usual; no snap concerns reported pregame.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected in CIN offense vs MIA.

items.text: Weekend summary: NOT EXPECTED - McConkey, Caleb, Dowdle, MHJ, Slayton, Palmer. GTD - Jefferson/Addison, Jeanty, McLaurin, DJ Moore. EXPECTED - Flowers, Tate, Stevenson, Kamara, Keenan. Later finals: Chase/Higgins play; Jeff expected/Addison not; Jeanty/McLaurin will play. Projections updated.
items.why: Critical Sunday AM pulse + live finals aligning Schefter/Rap.
items.implication: Messiest week; use for last-minute lineup locks.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries on OUT/INACTIVE (Warren, Wilson); reverse on unexpected IN.

items.text: Rico Dowdle out/not expected; coaching staffs (incl PIT) refused workhorse on Jaylen Warren pre-injury despite him passing advanced stats/eye test (Ekeler-esque). Now full opportunity.
items.why: Dowdle injury removes split; Levitan data/eye-test praise.
items.implication: Strong start Warren; high snap/carry/target share.
items.opportunity: Goal-line, third-down, two-minute, full RB1 role.

items.text: George Kittle officially active (illness earlier; expected to play vs SEA).
Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is active but not expected to play meaningful snaps (foot); earlier not expected at all.
items.why: Listed active late but Schefter clarifies no meaningful role; Johnston also out.
items.implication: Sit McConkey; decoy only if any snaps.
items.opportunity: Boosts other Chargers WRs (e.g. Tre Harris) for routes/targets.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery downgraded to out with groin injury.
items.implication: Sit Montgomery; HOU RB handcuff/backup elevated.
items.opportunity: Increased carries for remaining HOU backs.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams is officially inactive but has a chance to play next week (hamstring).
items.why: Official inactive list; next-week hopeful per Rap.
items.implication: Backup QB start; Bears pass game downgrade short-term.
items.opportunity: RBs/WRs may see more designed runs or simpler concepts.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (foot, Q) is expected to play vs. the Falcons.
items.why: Schefter morning confirmation; ETR listed expected.
items.implication: Start Flowers; Lamar out but still viable.

items.text: Alvin Kamara (back) expected to play vs Vikings; Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) expected to play for NE.
Marvin Harrison Jr has 5 catches in 4 games; wasn't a real factor. Elevates Michael Wilson opportunity (even pre-trade).
items.why: Low production/data shows MHJ peripheral; Wilson already benefiting.
items.implication: Wilson start/flex upgrade; MHJ trade accelerates.
items.opportunity: Wilson routes/targets/red-zone in ARI post-MHJ exit.

items.text: Marshawn Lloyd killing it on waiver wires everywhere.
items.implication: Priority waiver add for GB RB depth/handcuff upside.
items.opportunity: Potential expanded role if injuries or committee shifts.

items.text: Rain games totals dropping: CLE-NYJ 40→38.5; IND-PIT 43.5→42; NYG-WAS 44→41.5. Not all weather-related.
items.why: Live total moves in rainy slate games.
items.implication: Lower pass/scoring expectations; lean run-heavy or under in those spots.
items.opportunity: RB upgrade relative in rain; WRs/TEs caution.

items.text: Cruelest thing for MHJ drafters: not active to face Lions secondary.
items.implication: Frustration for owners; aligns with non-factor usage.

items.text: Chase Brown (The Brown Gobbler) gobbles targets/fantasy points; likes him a lot this week.
items.why: Target volume and production; nickname push.
items.opportunity: High target share + carries in CIN.
